studio_applicability.reason: The Studio product page advertises this resin and repeats mechanical values but cites Form 4 test conditions. It identifies a distinct Studio cartridge. Equivalence of cured density and coupon results on the user's Studio process has not been established.

design_equations.part_mass: m_i = rho_i * V_i; V_i from a closed manufactured-part mesh, in m^3
design_equations.assembly_mass: m = sum(m_i) + ballast + adhesive + finish + retained_process_material
design_equations.assembly_cg: r_CG = sum(m_i * r_i) / sum(m_i), including all assembly additions
design_equations.rectangular_fin_bending: EI = E * b * t^3 / 12; ideal homogeneous-section approximation, not an entire ray-supported fin model

limitations: Manufacturer coupon measurements are evidence about their test conditions, not independent Frontier measurements.
Geometry, orientation, settings, curing and temperature affect properties; no specimen-level uncertainty distribution is provided.
Do not infer survival of a slingshot launch or impact from elongation at break or bulk modulus alone.
These are photopolymer manufacturing materials, not living tissue or a demonstrated bioink.
Form 4 Grey V5 minimum-feature guidance is not automatically applicable to Alpha resin on Form Studio 1.
